chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Hisham al-Khurasani, from al-Mufazzal ibn Umar, who said:

I was in the presence of Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) in Kufa during the days when Abu al-Abbas arrived. When we reached al-Kunasa, he (peace be upon him) said: 'Here was where my uncle Zayd was crucified, may Allah have mercy on him.' Then he continued until he reached the stall of the oilmen, which is the end of the lamp-makers, and he dismounted and said: 'Dismount, for this place was the first Masjid of Kufa, which Adam (peace be upon him) marked, and I dislike entering it while riding.'

I said: 'So who changed it from its original marking?' He said: 'As for the first one, it was the Flood in the time of Noah (peace be upon him). Then the companions of Kisra and Nu'man changed it, and after that Ziyad ibn Abi Sufyan changed it.'

I said: 'And was Kufa and its mosque in the time of Noah (peace be upon him)?' He said to me: 'Yes, O Mufazzal. And the dwelling of Noah and his people was in a town, at a place from the Euphrates that faces the west of Kufa.'

He said: 'And Noah (peace be upon him) was a carpenter, so Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, made him a Prophet and chose him. And Noah (peace be upon him) was the first to make a ship that sails on the surface of the water.'

He said: 'And Noah (peace be upon him) remained among his people for a thousand years except fifty years, calling them to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic. They would mock him and laugh at him. So when he saw that from them, he supplicated against them, saying: 'My Lord! Do not leave upon the earth any dwelling of the disbelievers. Indeed, if You leave them, they will lead astray Your servants and will not give birth except to a wicked, ungrateful one.'
So Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, revealed to Noah: 'Make a ship, and make it spacious, and hasten its work.'
So Noah built a ship in the Masjid of Kufa with his own hands. He brought the wood from afar until he finished it.

Al-Mufazzal said: 'Then the hadith of Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) was interrupted at the time of the sun's decline. So Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) stood up and prayed Dhuhr and Asr, then left the mosque. He turned to his left and pointed with his hand to the place of the house of al-Darriyyin, which is the place of the house of Ibn Hakim, and that is the Euphrates today.'
He said to me: 'O Mufazzal! And here were set up the idols of the people of Noah (peace be upon him): Yaghuth, Ya'quth, and Nasr.'

Then he continued until he mounted his animal. I said: 'May I be your ransom, in how long did Noah build his ship until he finished it?' He said: 'In two periods.' I said: 'And how long are the two periods?' He said: 'Eighty years.' I said: 'And indeed the general public say that he built it in five hundred years.' He said: 'No! How is it, and by Allah, it has been revealed to us?'
I said: 'Inform me about the statement of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic:
Until when Our command came and the oven overflowed
He said: 'The oven was in the house of an elderly believing woman, behind the Qiblah of the right side of the mosque.' I said to him: 'For that is the place of the corner of Bab al-Feel today.'
Then I said to him: 'And was the beginning of the water's emergence from that oven?' He said: 'Yes. Indeed, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, loved to show the people of Noah a sign.'

Then indeed Allah, Blessed and Exalted, sent rain upon them flooding with a flood, and the Euphrates overflowed with a flood, and all the springs overflowed with a flood. So Allah, Exalted is His mention, drowned them and saved Noah and those with him in the ship.

I said to him: 'How long did Noah remain in the ship until the water subsided and they came out of it?' He said: 'They remained in it for seven days and their nights. And it circled around the House for a week, then it settled on al-Judiyy, and that is the Euphrates of Kufa.'

I said to him: 'Indeed, the Masjid of Kufa is old.' He said: 'Yes, and it is the prayer place of the Prophets (peace be upon them). And indeed the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) prayed in it when he was taken on an ascension to the sky.'

So Jibra'il (peace be upon him) said to him: 'O Muhammad! This is the mosque of your father Adam (peace be upon him) and the prayer place of the Prophets (peace be upon them). So descend and pray in it.' So he descended and prayed in it.
Then indeed Jibra'il (peace be upon him) ascended with him to the sky.

key_terms.الْجُودِيِّ: Al-Judiyy (the place where the ark settled)

ai.seo_question: Where was the first mosque in Kufa and what is the significance of the 'oven' in the story of Noah's flood?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) identifies the first mosque in Kufa as the site marked by Adam (AS), linking it to the history of Noah (AS) who built his ark there over eighty years. The narration clarifies that the 'oven' (Tannur) mentioned in the Quran was the source of the flood's initial waters, located in the house of a believing woman, and notes that the Ark rested on Al-Judiyy, identified as the Euphrates near Kufa. This hadith highlights the spiritual significance of Kufa as a place of prayer for prophets, including Muhammad (SAW) during his Night Journey.

en.hubeali: H 14869 – Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Hisham Al-Khurasany, from Al-Mufazzal Bin Umar who said:

I was in the presence of Abu Abdullahasws at Al-Kufa in the days of Ali Bin Al-Abbas. So when we ended up to Al-Kunasa, heasws said: ‘Over there is where they crucified myasws uncle Zayd, may Allahazwj have Mercy upon him’. Then we went until we ended up at the (market) stall of the oilmen, and it was at the end of the two lamps. So heasws descended and said: ‘Descend, for this is the place where the Masjid Al-Kufa used to be at first which Adamas had marked, and Iasws do not like that Iasws should enter it riding’.

I said, ‘So who was the other one who had marked it?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘As for the first one, that was the storm during the era of Noah<sup>as</sup>. Then others from the companions of Chosroe and Nu’man, and thereafter Ziyad Bin Abu Sufyan’.

So I said, ‘And there was a Masjid at Al-Kufa during the era of Noah<sup>as</sup>?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said to me; ‘Yes, O Mufazzal. And the houses of Noah<sup>as</sup> and his<sup>as</sup> people were in a town, at a place from the Euphrates which follows west of Al-Kufa’.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And Noah<sup>as</sup> was a carpenter. So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Made him<sup>as</sup> a Prophet<sup>as</sup> and Answered him<sup>as</sup>. And Noah<sup>as</sup> was the first one to make a ship which flowed upon the back of the water’.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And Noah<sup>as</sup> lived among his<sup>as</sup> people for fifty years less a thousand years (950), calling them to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic. However, they derided him<sup>as</sup> and laughed at him<sup>as</sup>. So when he<sup>as</sup> saw that from them, he<sup>as</sup> supplicated against them saying: ‘Lord<sup>azwj</sup>! Do not Leave upon the earth any house of the infidels. If You<sup>azwj</sup> Leave them, they will lead astray Your<sup>azwj</sup> servants, and will not give birth to anyone except the infidel tyrants’.
So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Revealed unto Noah<sup>as</sup> that he<sup>as</sup> should make a ship and make it a big one, and hurriedly.
So Noah<sup>as</sup> made a ship in Masjid Al-Kufa by his<sup>as</sup> hands. He brought the wood from afar until he<sup>as</sup> finished it.

Al-Mufazzal said, ‘Then Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> interrupted the Hadith during the sunset. So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> stood up and Prayed the Midday Salat (Al-Zohar), and the Afternoon Salat (Al-Asar), then left from the Masjid. He<sup>asws</sup> indicated by his<sup>asws</sup> hand to his<sup>asws</sup> left to a place where there was a house among the houses, and it was the place of the house of Ibn Hakeym, and where is Euphrates today,
so heasws said to me: ‘O Mufazzal! Over there is where the idols of the people of Noahas were fixed – Yagows, and Yaowq, and Nasraa’.

Then he<sup>asws</sup> went and rode upon his<sup>asws</sup> animal. So I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>, how long did it take for Noah<sup>as</sup> to build his<sup>as</sup> ship until he<sup>as</sup> finished it?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘In two time periods’. I said, ‘And how long are these two time periods?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Eighty years’. I said, ‘The general Muslim are saying that he<sup>as</sup> built it over five hundred years’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No! How are they saying this, and by Allah<sup>azwj</sup> it has been Revealed to us<sup>asws</sup>?’
I said, ‘Inform me about the Statement of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>:
“[23:27] and when Our command is given and the oven overflows”

so where is its place and how was it?’ Heasws said: ‘It was the oven in the house of an elderly believing woman in the direction of the Qiblah, on the right of the Masjid’. I said to himasws, ‘So that is the place of the corner of the Baab Al-Feel today’.
Then I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘And that is oven where the water started coming from?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Loved to show a sign to the people of Noah<sup>as</sup>.

Then Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Sent rain upon them which flooded them with a flood, and the Euphrates overflowed with a flood, and then all the rivers overflowed. Thus Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Drowned all of them and saved Noah<sup>as</sup> and those who were with him<sup>as</sup> in the ship’.

So I said to him, ‘How long did Noah<sup>as</sup> remain in the ship until the water subsided, and he<sup>as</sup> came out from it?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He<sup>as</sup> remained in it for seven days and nights. It circled around the House for a week, then settled upon the Mount Joudy, and it is Euphrates of Al-Kufa’.

I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The Masjid of Al-Kufa is old?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, and it is a Praying place of Prophets<sup>as</sup>, and the Rasool Allah<sup>saww</sup> had Prayed in it when he<sup>saww</sup> Taken on an ascension to the sky.

So Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> said to him<sup>as</sup>: ‘O Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>! This is a Mosque of your<sup>saww</sup> father Adam<sup>as</sup>, and a Praying Place of the Prophets<sup>as</sup>’. So he<sup>saww</sup> descended and Prayed therein.
Then Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> ascended with him<sup>saww</sup> to the sky’.
en.sarwar: 422. Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Abaan Bin Usmaan, from Abu Hamza Al-Thumaly, from Abu Razeyn Al-Asady, who has narrated the following:

Amir-ul- Momineen (a.s.) said: ‘When Noah (a.s.) was free from building the ship and there were (many) seasons between him (as) and his (as) Lord (azwj) for the destruction of his (as) people, the overflowing of the oven.
His (as) wife said, ‘The oven has overflowed’.
So he (as) stood up and covered it.
And he (as) entered into the ship whosoever that he (as) wanted to, and exited from it whosoever he (as) wanted to.
Then he (as) came to his (as) covering and took it off.

Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic Said: “[54:11] So We opened the gates of the sky with water pouring [54:12] And We made water to flow forth in the land in springs, so the water gathered together according to a measure already ordained [54:13] And We bore him on that which was made of planks and nails”.
And he (as) had built it in the middle of your Masjid and it was of seven hundred cubits’.
